topic.title: Identifier Renamed on Both Sides
topic.shortdesc: Both users rename the same identifiers, to different values. The elements themselves must still be recognised as the same elements.

section.title: Overview
section.p: Tokens are signed with the key configured in auth.signing.key.
The service limits are described in Limits.

ul.li: A JDK 21 runtime is installed on the host.
The database schema is migrated to revision 42.

section.title: Limits
section.p: Every limit below is applied per client identifier.
A request that exceeds a limit is answered with 429.
